task_transfer.output: Model wire output nests evidence within each selected label. Deterministic encoding produces the unchanged canonical label_ids/explanation/evidence/bullet_ids fields, retaining all model-selected labels and quotes. Repeated label groups represent multiple evidence groups; the canonical label list is their ordered unique union. Coding and insufficient_context are mutually exclusive schema branches. No label is guessed, dropped, or repaired using GT.
task_transfer.ace: Original generator, GT/no-GT reflector and curator prompts; unchanged pinned playbook function ASTs; ADD only, stable IDs and helpful/harmful counters; one reflection and curation per item; no dedup analyzer.
task_transfer.dc: Unchanged pinned advanced_generate function AST, DynamicCheatsheet_Cumulative, one round, provider generation overridden by the common native runtime; no code execution. Generator explanation is additionally bounded to 1600 Unicode characters and explicitly excludes repetitive solution narration. Curator emits 1-24 complete structured description/example/usage-count items, with text bounds of 160/320 Unicode characters. The adapter renders all model-authored fields into the original memory-item tags and supplies the outer cheatsheet wrapper. This additional declared serialization constraint prevents unbounded repetitive body generation; it is a task-transfer format constraint, not an exact reproduction of the original free-form curator. No reconstruction of truncated content, no post-hoc trimming or deduplication.
task_transfer.gt: Current GT read only after durable prediction commit; no labels or evaluator feedback in GT-no. No current or future GT supplied to prediction.
task_transfer.memory: 4096 tokenizer tokens; reject complete oversized candidates and retain prior state, with a logged rejected update.
task_transfer.failures: Reject verified exhausted malformed/length/incomplete curator output and retain previous memory. Infrastructure, source, GT, and generator failures still stop. No invented curator response. This changes r4 fail-stop semantics and is a separately reported DC variant.
task_transfer.restart: Immutable per-item prediction and update commits; replay checkpoints and request cache to resume without duplicate updates.
task_transfer.dependencies: Only unchanged upstream function ASTs/constants execute; provider initializers, dotenv and external-client imports do not execute.
task_transfer.concurrency: Eight independent GPU streams, one request at a time per stream; throughput profile, not single-GPU reference timing.
